title: Tech Note: Tab Objects within Tab Objects

historical_commentary.text: Tab Control form objects remain a supported, still-used 4D form object today, so the core technique of nesting tab controls for hierarchical navigation remains directly applicable in current 4D applications, making this a still relevant, if dated in specific presentation, piece of UI guidance.
related_updates: 4D's Tab Control form object remains supported in current versions, so the nesting technique described here is still broadly applicable
